definitions.explanation: A person who owns land. Historically refers to wealthy landowners who leased land to tenant farmers. In modern usage, refers to anyone who owns real property.

examples.japanese: {地主|じぬし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: To get permission from the landowner.

examples.japanese: {地主|じぬし}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{借地人|しゃくちにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦トラブル→トラブル：07061_toraburu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: A dispute arose between the landowner and the tenant.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦前|せんぜん}→戦前：12852_senzen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大|おお}{地主|じぬし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広大|こうだい}→広大：11328_koudai⟧な⟦{農地|のうち}→農地：14354_nouchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{所有|しょゆう}→所有：12752_shoyuu⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In prewar Japan, large landowners possessed vast farmland.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
The {地主|じぬし} system was central to pre-modern Japanese agriculture. Large landowners leased rice paddies to tenant farmers ({小作人|こさくにん}), who paid rent in rice. After World War II, the Allied occupation carried out land reform (⟦{農地|のうち}→農地：14354_nouchi⟧⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧), breaking up large estates and distributing land to tenant farmers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大|おお}{地主|じぬし}: large landowner
- {地主|じぬし}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{小作人|こさくにん}: landowner and tenant farmer
- ⟦{不在|ふざい}→不在：11302_fuzai⟧{地主|じぬし}: absentee landlord
